text_block_list.text:
With the autumn Tenno Sho in the
books, Mejiro
McQueen and I decide to
have a holiday party.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having purchased cake, groceries, and a
variety
of other things, I make my way
back.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Trainer. Welcome back.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Judging from your demeanor,
you haven't
yet noticed.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You see, I added a decoration while you
were
absent.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Well? Can you find it?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I look around the room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's a small, wrapped cookie sitting
on the
desk! What's more, it's shaped
like the plaque of
the Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You seem to have spotted it!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I used a mold to make it into the shape
of a
shield. I know it isn't much.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
But it's my way of showing thanks for
leading me
toward my victories in the
Twin Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Please savor and enjoy this token of my
esteem.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I try Мэдзиро МакКуин's handmade,
shield-shaped
cookie.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What's that?! Let me try.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Crunch...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Urgh... You're right. This is definitely
burnt...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I tried so hard to make you happy.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Really?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I see. After all, the emotions I felt
as I made
this for you were genuine.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
As long as I was able to convey my
feelings, that
is enough for me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I decide to try Мэдзиро МакКуин's
handmade,
shield-shaped cookie.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh my, really?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness... I put my heart into
making it,
and now I know it was all
worth the effort.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: It's a relief to see the smile on your face.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You know how much effort I've
been
putting toward my goal all this
time, yes?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
After all that work, I successfully
achieved my
goal, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps as a consequence of my
single-minded
focus, I feel that I've
neglected a part of my
personal life.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
So, when I saw your smile just now, it
gave me a
sense of relief. I can celebrate
without restraint.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Yes... absolutely!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Since that's settled, why don't we get
our glasses
and have a toast?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
After that, we cut loose and enjoy our
holiday
party until curfew.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We enjoy the rest of our holiday party,
taking
things easier than usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
